display.purpose: Page-level h1 only — route titles like "Today", "Activities", "Progress", or an activity name.

body.purpose: Default UI text — nav, buttons, section subheads, meta descriptions.

label.purpose: StatTile's uppercase caption. The system's only uppercase-tracked role.

mono.purpose: Every measurement, count, duration, and pace value, at any size.

shadows.name: toast-float
shadows.purpose: The one floating element (UpdatePrompt) — never used on in-flow cards.

motion.name: toast-in
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), 0.5s, from opacity:0 translateY(-8px) scale(0.98) to opacity:1 translateY(0) scale(1)
motion.purpose: Reserved entrance for the live-arrival moment; currently defined in CSS but not yet applied to a shipped component.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important action on screen — e.g. "Connect Strava".
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2dd4bf; color: #0b0f14; border: none; border-radius: 11px; padding: 10px 12px; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f1f4f7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A low-commitment optional action, e.g. enabling notifications.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost">Notify me when an activity lands</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #8792a0; border: 1px dashed rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #8792a0; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f1f4f7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stat Tile
components.description: The core metric display — a mono numeral over an uppercase caption.
components.css: .ds-stat-tile { background: #141b23; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); border-radius: 15px; padding: 16px; } .ds-stat-value { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: #2dd4bf; } .ds-stat-unit { margin-left: 4px; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #8792a0; } .ds-stat-label { margin-top: 4px; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8792a0; }

components.name: Activity Row
components.description: One record in the activity timeline — sport dot, name, mono meta.
components.html: Morning Run8.2 km · 42:10 · 5:08/km
components.css: .ds-activity-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #141b23; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); border-radius: 13px; padding: 12px 16px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-activity-row:hover { background: #1d2530; } .ds-sport-dot { flex: none; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-activity-name { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #f1f4f7; } .ds-activity-meta { flex: none; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #8792a0; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar nav link, active and inactive states.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: block; border-radius: 11px; padding: 10px 12px; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #8792a0; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #1d2530; } .ds-nav-item--active { background: #1d2530; color: #f1f4f7; }

components.name: Tab
components.css: .ds-tablist { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-tab { border: none; background: transparent; border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #8792a0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-tab:hover { background: #1d2530; } .ds-tab--active { background: #1d2530; color: #f1f4f7; }

components.name: Mix Bar
components.description: Per-sport horizontal proportion bar in the Progress view's workout-mix panel.
components.css: .ds-mixbar-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-mixbar-label { flex: none; width: 96px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #f1f4f7; } .ds-mixbar-track { flex: 1; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #1d2530; overflow: hidden; } .ds-mixbar-fill { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-mixbar-pct { flex: none; width: 40px; text-align: right; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #8792a0; }

narrative.overview:
Trainingdash reads as a piece of instrumentation, not a lifestyle app: a near-black surface, one glowing signal color, and every number set in mono type like a raw readout rather than a decorated stat. There is no chrome for chrome's sake — the interface is a sidebar and a stack of cards, and almost all of its personality lives in four things: the depth ladder between background steps, the hairline borders, the single teal signal, and the closed four-color sport palette that repeats identically across activity dots, chart series, and the workout-mix bars.

This is a deliberate rejection of generic fitness-app cheerfulness — no bright gradients, no rounded-friendly illustration, no motivational color-pop UI. It is closer to a single-operator console: quiet by default, and the one accent color is reserved for the thing that actually matters on screen (a live streak, a CTA, the route itself).

Interactive surfaces are tactile and precise: state changes read as a deliberate switch flip (background steps from card/transparent to raised-panel) rather than a soft hover fade. Nothing animates without reason — the one motion primitive currently defined (toast-in) is reserved for exactly one job: announcing that something just arrived.
keyCharacteristics: One signal color (Signal Teal) carries all "this is active/primary" meaning across buttons, the current streak stat, the weekly-distance bar, the calendar heatmap peak, and the route line.
Depth comes from a four-step background ladder (Void Black → Deep Panel → Terminal Card → Raised Panel) plus hairline borders — not shadows.
Every number is set in JetBrains Mono; every label is either a bold sans headline or a small uppercase mono-adjacent tag. There is no in-between.
A closed, non-negotiable four-color sport palette (Run Teal / Strength Magenta / Ride Violet / Walk Blue) is the only place color carries categorical (not just state) meaning.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Teal is the only color that means "primary / active / this matters." It never appears as decoration — every instance of it on screen is doing semantic work (a CTA, the current streak, the top of a chart, the route). If a new element needs emphasis, reach for Signal Teal only if that emphasis is genuinely primary; otherwise use the raised-panel background step instead.

rules.name: The Closed Sport Palette Rule
rules.body: The four sport colors are a fixed lookup table (Run/TrailRun, Ride/VirtualRide, Walk/Hike, WeightTraining/Workout), consumed identically by ActivityRow's dot, MixBar's fill, and the future legend of any new chart. A new sport type falls back to Instrument Gray rather than inventing a fifth color.

rules.name: The All-Numbers-Are-Mono Rule
rules.body: Any value that is a measurement, count, duration, or pace renders in JetBrains Mono, regardless of font size or where it sits. Sans type is reserved for labels, names, and prose.

rules.name: The One Uppercase Rule
rules.body: Uppercase + letter-spacing is reserved for StatTile captions. It does not migrate to nav items, section headers, or buttons — those stay sentence case and bold instead.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: No component gets a shadow for being "important" or "elevated" in the ordinary card/tile/row sense — use the next background step up instead. A shadow is reserved for elements that are literally floating above the page (toasts, future popovers/modals), never for in-flow cards.

dos: Do keep Signal Teal to a single, consistent semantic role (primary/active/current) across every surface — button, stat, chart, map alike.
Do use the background-ladder step (not a shadow) whenever a component needs to read as "raised" or "focused."
Do render every measurement, count, duration, and pace value in JetBrains Mono, at whatever size the context calls for.
Do treat the four sport colors as a closed, fixed lookup table shared by every component that displays a sport type.
Do reserve uppercase + letter-spacing exclusively for StatTile-style meta captions.
donts: Don't add a shadow to an in-flow card, tile, or row — shadows are reserved for elements floating above the page (toasts, future modals/popovers).
Don't introduce a second "primary" accent color alongside Signal Teal, or use Signal Teal purely decoratively.
Don't invent a fifth sport color ad hoc; fall back to Instrument Gray for an unmapped sport type instead.
Don't reach for bright, rounded, "cheerful fitness app" visual language (illustration, gradients-as-decoration, playful iconography) — the system is a quiet instrument panel, not a lifestyle brand.
Don't repurpose Arrival Amber/Gold or the toast-in animation for anything other than the live-arrival moment they're reserved for.
